facts.text: Andrew has a new puppy named Toby who is described as a bundle of joy.

evidence.quote: meet Toby, my puppy. He's a bundle of joy and I couldn't resist taking him home, city living and all.

facts.text: Andrew has been feeling stressed due to work and misses the freedom of going for a hike.

evidence.quote: Since we last talked, work has been piling up and I've been stuck inside. I miss the peace and feeling of freedom that comes with going for a hike.

facts.text: Andrew plans to go hiking next month and has invited Audrey and her dogs to join.

evidence.quote: I have plans for a hike next month and thought it'd be cool if you and the pups could come along.

facts.text: Audrey has made personalized tags for her dogs and is excited about the planned hike.

evidence.quote: I made these personalized tags for them. Take a look!
